title: [dbf24d0c] deploy/config/deploy-monitoring.yaml
content:
# config/deploy-monitoring.yaml
deployment:
  name: plaza-monitoring-v2
  type: blue-green
  health_check:
    endpoint: /api/v1/health
    interval: 10s
    timeout: 5s
  rollback:
    strategy: immediate
    timeout: 30s
  monitoring:
    sampling_config: config/sampling-configmap.yaml
    schema_registry: config/schema-registry.yaml
